pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit polygonal geometry with predominantly smooth pixel gradients at the edges due to image blur. Relative spatial area is highest on the mid-flank, with individual patches becoming smaller and more elongated toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous lattice of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three to four pathways intersect. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the torso but appears slightly wider and more diffuse at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck and shoulder line against the background.
